notes.title: New Demo Available Now!
notes.content: [h1]Hey everyone! [/h1][p][/p][p]We have just launched a new demo of [i][b]The Lacerator[/b][/i]!  [/p][p]We are working [i]very hard[/i] on the full game and wanted to let you taste a bit more of how the laceration system affects the player and the areas you can access!  [/p][p]If you have played the original demo, I encourage you to download this new one and try taking a different path, [u][b]you’ll get surprised![/b][/u]  [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ikPIda7nMa4;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]DEMO CHANGES[/h2][list][*][p]New playable areas![/p][/*][*][p]Multiple New Endings[/p][/*][*][p]Added Laser Sights to guns  [/p][/*][*][p]New Puzzles  [/p][/*][*][p]New Cutscenes  [/p][/*][*][p]New Lacerations  [/p][list][*][p]You can get your legs cut off and crawl around to access unique areas  [/p][/*][*][p]You can get your penis cut off!  [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Items and Special Weapons[/p][/*][*][p]The Man in the Wall[/p][list][*][p]A mysterious character you can trade items with[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New first-time start up options screens  [/p][/*][*][p]New [b][i]SEXY[/i][/b] Logo  [/p][/*][*][p][i]A bunch of general bug fixes and polish[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The demo is available for review too, and we are very excited to know what you think about it! The release date is getting closer and closer and we appreciate all your juicy feedback.  Can you adapt and survive?  [/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]NOW AVAILABLE IN 4K[/u][/b][/h3][p](this is a joke the graphics are still f*cked up)) [/p][p]Have fun 😄 [/p][p]- Games From The Abyss  [/p]
